The *Paṭhamanāgavimānavatthu* ("Elephant Mansion", Vv 60) is a verse text included in the *Vimānavatthu* of the Pali Tipiṭaka. In this narrative, a celestial being (*deva*) describes the great karmic fruit earned by offering eight flowers at the stupa of the past Buddha Kassapa.
